outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic and a set of western blots; it contains no bar/summary plot requiring individual data points.

Bar charts show a single densitometric quantification per antibody derived from the single IP blot in panel A (no error bars, no stated replicate number), so these do not represent an average of multiple replicates that would require overlaid individual points.
Panel C is a heatmap, a plot type exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D is a violin plot, which already displays the underlying data distribution and is exempt from needing overlaid individual points.
Panel E is a bar chart explicitly stated as n=4, mean ± SD, and individual data points (open circles for each of the 4 replicates) are overlaid on each bar for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a quantitative summary plot.
Panel G consists of scatterplots, where the plotted points are themselves the individual data; scatterplots are exempt from this check.
Panel H is a scatterplot of individual IP-MS experiments; scatterplots are exempt from this check.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot where each point is an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt from this check.
Panel J comprises PCA scatterplots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum) where each point is an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt from this check.
